Top quarantine reasons: Too few OOS trades (watch+) 9,159 · Stale pre-fix engine (leveraged) 2,690 · Engine not covered by tests 1,857 · Proxy / guessed costs 1,341.
How it works: each engine must pass unit tests before any wave launches (a liquidation costs the full margin, no lookahead, random and shuffled placebos earn nothing, cost floor, buy-and-hold and P&L reconciliation). Then every result is checked row by row. Only validated rows appear in the charts, tables and Promising. Extreme but unproven results go to audit instead of being hidden.

Promising strategies

Only rows that passed the validation gate (tested engine, real costs, enough trades, audited if extreme). Live and paper strategies, plus the best backtests that beat buy-and-hold on a risk-adjusted basis, with at least 5 out-of-sample (OOS) trades, and no guessed option costs. Near-identical parameter variants are folded into one card. OOS = Jan 2023–Mar 2025 test data the rule was not tuned on (Robinhood trend/dip rows use 2017–Mar 2025). "Locked holdout" = Apr 2025–Oct 2026 data, opened once. DSR p = deflated-Sharpe p-value; below 0.05 passes the overfitting check. P(goal) = bootstrap chance of hitting the book goal within a year. Backtests are not promises: big drawdowns are shown in red.

Heat map: validated tests, grouped by family

Each family shows its full validated count and average OOS CAGR, but the grid shows the 40 strongest families per book and about 80 tests in each family (every live, candidate, or paper row, plus a spread of the rest) so the page stays a few megabytes. Totals above still count every validated test. Outliers under audit and quarantined rows are listed separately below. Families are ordered most→least profitable by each family's best OOS CAGR (falls back to in-sample CAGR when OOS is missing); cells inside a family use the same sort key, best to worst. The colour is OOS CAGR measured against the book's goal: red is a loss, grey is flat, green is a gain, and gold marks a test that meets the goal (failed and cost-estimate/proxy-option rows are hidden). Faded cells have no OOS result, so the colour shows in-sample. A white outline marks a candidate. Tap or hover a cell for details.

In-sample vs out-of-sample CAGR

Overfit strategies sit far right and low: great in-sample, poor OOS. Both axes are log(1+CAGR). The dashed line is y = x, and the gold lines are each book's goal.

Looking good ()

Status watch, candidate, forward-paper or live, or OOS CAGR > 0 with a robustness pass. "MC goal" is the share of 100k bootstrap paths that reach the book's goal. "Robust" means every ±20% parameter nudge and 2x costs stay profitable. "Holdout" is the locked Apr 2025–Oct 2026 result, evaluated once for frozen finalists only. Rows that failed the holdout are left out. Click a column header to sort.
